name: Navigation Local Tasks
description: Display local tasks in the Navigation toolbar via blocks.
project_description:
Enhances the content editing experience by providing blocks to display local tasks (View, Edit, Delete etc) in the core Navigation toolbar.

 The module offers four display options:

 
 Action buttons (dev) 
 Dropdown button 
 Expandable details 
 Expandable menu 
 
 An administrator can configure which tasks are displayed.

 Back to top 

 Similar modules 
 
 Navigation Extra 
 
 How it is different? This module focuses only on the local tasks and provides different "widgets" for presenting them.
